models_evaluated: convolutional neural network (deep learning chest radiograph classifiers)

links.outcome: AUC under mismatched exposure parameter distributions (pneumothorax, COVID-19, race classification)
links.effect: Pneumothorax AUC fell from 0.94 (95% CI 0.94, 0.95) to 0.56 (0.55, 0.58), ΔAUC -0.38; COVID-19 ΔAUC -0.33; race classification ΔAUC -0.09 (all P<.001).
links.quote: For pneumothorax detection, AUC decreased from 0.94 (95% CI: 0.94, 0.95) to 0.56 (95% CI: 0.55, 0.58) on mismatched exposure distributions (ΔAUC, -0.38; P < .001).

links.outcome: Model performance in high-risk exposure regimes within natural distribution versus typical exposures
links.effect: A priori exposure-regimen screening found high-risk regimes within the natural distribution associated with reduced model performance compared with typical exposures.
links.quote: The a priori exposure-regimen screening revealed high-risk regimes within the natural distribution that were associated with reduced model performance compared with typical exposures.

unlisted_practices: Exposure-regimen audits of imaging acquisition parameters to flag high-risk conditions before clinical deployment
Testing for shortcut learning on DICOM metadata/acquisition parameters

screen.reason: Evaluates shortcut learning in chest radiography models and tests an a priori exposure-regimen screening/auditing safeguard to flag high-risk acquisition conditions prior to deployment.
